title: Why Does Structured Output Fail? An Empirical Study of Prompt-Enforced Pydantic Schemas Across Nine LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.33949v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pipelines that require structured outputs from hosted language models often specify a Pydantic schema in the prompt, validate the response, and retry when validation fails. Although native structured-output modes provide an alternative, application-side validation remains important for enforcing custom constraints. Yet pipeline reliability is often summarized by a single validity rate, which obscures why outputs fail and which interventions may help. We introduce a fine-grained taxonomy of schema-conformance failures and a deterministic classifier that assigns failure categories from model responses and Pydantic validation errors. We apply this framework to 3,997 generation attempts across nine OpenAI and Anthropic model/API configurations, using questions from HotpotQA and FinanceBench. Our results show that similar validity rates can mask different failure patterns, and that dominant failure categories vary with schema constraints an

translated_title: 为什么结构化输出会失败？对九个大语言模型中提示词强制执行的Pydantic模式的实证研究
translated_abstract: 需要从托管语言模型获取结构化输出的流水线通常在提示词中指定Pydantic模式，对响应进行验证，并在验证失败时重试。尽管原生结构化输出模式提供了一种替代方案，但应用侧验证对于强制执行自定义约束仍然十分重要。然而，流水线可靠性通常仅用单一的有效率来概括，这掩盖了输出失败的原因以及哪些干预措施可能有效。我们引入了一种细粒度的模式符合性失败分类法，以及一个确定性分类器，该分类器根据模型响应和Pydantic验证错误分配失败类别。我们将此框架应用于九种OpenAI和Anthropic模型/API配置下的3,997次生成尝试，使用来自HotpotQA和FinanceBench的问题。我们的结果表明，相似的有效率可能掩盖不同的失败模式，且主导失败类别随模式约束而变化。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个细粒度的模式符合性失败分类法和确定性分类器，通过对九个大语言模型配置的3,997次生成实验，揭示了单一有效率指标所掩盖的多样化失败模式，并发现主导失败类别会随模式约束的不同而变化。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a fine-grained taxonomy of schema-conformance failures and a deterministic classifier, revealing through 3,997 generation attempts across nine LLM configurations that similar validity rates can mask diverse failure patterns whose dominant categories vary with schema constraints.
